name: sm-tax-overview
description: Overview of the San Marino tax system for 2026 and a router to the detailed San Marino skills. Covers the tax year, currency and authorities, residence and worldwide taxation, the IGR income tax with eight bands from 9% to 35%, the 18% rate for companies and for business and professional income in tax years 2026 to 2030 (17% statutory), the 50% new-company rate cut, the single-stage import tax (monofase) at 17% in place of VAT, ISS social contributions and FONDISS, withholding on payments abroad, the 31 July return deadline, and the 2026 reforms (Law 141/2025, Delegated Decree 156/2026, domestic e-invoicing from 2027). Use for a first answer on San Marino tax, comparing San Marino with Italy, or choosing which San Marino skill to load.
